brainbread 2 the sequel to the hl1 mod into the source engine
and ho boy its pretty good

pros
pve and pvp at the same time
game runs very smoothly (depending on what server though)
very fun
great modding community

cons
some bugs such as a zombie somehow one shotting a military ally
game is not really that played (although it really should in my personal opinion)
level only saves server wise (my guess is that they don't want a random level 100 walking around with a minigun all the time)


besides the cons i encountered this game is very well done
i can't wait to see what comes up in future updates! (hopefully the bugs can get fixed up to)
